description: This file is a bash script used for configuring iOS signing settings in a project. It sets various bundle IDs, team IDs, and signing styles, generating a configuration file for local-only use.

methods.name: sanitize_identifier_segment
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be used as a segment in identifiers by lowercasing, replacing invalid characters with hyphens, and handling empty strings.

methods.name: normalize_bundle_id
methods.description: Normalizes a bundle identifier string by lowercasing, replacing invalid characters, collapsing dots, and handling empty strings.
